results.caption: Original Video Credit: IG/maryjeanes At participating Petco stores, customers can refill reusable containers with So Phresh cat litter instead of purchasing a new container every time. The process involves scooping bulk litter from a large refill station into an existing bucket, offering a convenient alternative to repeatedly buying prepackaged litter. The system uses a bulk dispensing station that stores loose cat litter in a large reservoir, allowing customers to transfer the amount needed into a compatible reusable container. By keeping the original bucket and refilling it during subsequent visits, customers can reduce the amount of single-use packaging associated with routine pet care purchases. Refill stations demonstrate how reusable packaging can be incorporated into everyday retail shopping. For cat owners, the approach can offer savings compared with purchasing new containers, depending on local pricing, while helping reduce plastic consumption. My mom used to clean houses, babysit kids, and then when my sibling was diagnosed with cancer, she took care of them full-time. We grew up off $28,000 a year, family of five, and I was the eldest daughter. So I had to do a lot of translating, helping with my younger siblings, and overall just carrying a lot on my shoulders. My parents came to the U.S. to escape poverty and violence, so they always told me, Estudia, mija, estudia. So I did. I was so angry because I missed out on so many opportunities because we didn't have money for them. I missed out on prom, SAT tutoring, and extracurriculars for college.
